title: Milestone 2: CLI App
subtitle: Loops and Logic in action.
goal: Build a command-line app using loops, lists, and logic.

blocks.heading: Building a Task Manager
blocks.html: Now that you know loops and lists, you can build a real app that runs continuously. We're going to build a To-Do List app.

blocks.heading: The Requirements
blocks.html: Open VS Code. Create todo.py. The program should loop forever until the user types 'quit'. It should offer choices: View tasks, Add a task, or Quit.

blocks.caption: Starter structure
blocks.code:
tasks = []
while True:
    print("\n1. View Tasks\n2. Add Task\n3. Quit")
    choice = input("Choose an option: ")
    
    if choice == '3':
        print("Goodbye!")
        break
    # Add the rest of the logic here
